author: Leon Made This / s010s

description.en: Genus-labelled whole fossil-shell interpretation informed by the Röpsen Horridonia horrida museum photograph: inflated central shell, dominant lateral shafts and simplified fan spines. Unseen closure, dimensions, palette and spine counts are nominal artistic choices; no matrix fins, hidden soft anatomy or specimen metrology claimed.
description.zh: 以 Röpsen 馆藏 Horridonia horrida 照片为依据的属级完整化石壳解释，保留膨起中央壳体、粗壮侧刺和简化扇状细刺；不可见闭合面、尺度、颜色和刺数为创作，不把基质当壳翼或宣称实测复原。
